title: Two-Wheeler Package Policy
summary: Comprehensive cover for your Pavan Breeze 125 scooter, MH 12 ME 7781, with owner-driver accident cover and roadside assistance.

clauses.title: The insured vehicle
clauses.text: This policy covers the two-wheeler described in the Schedule, a Pavan Breeze 125 scooter registered as MH 12 ME 7781, together with its manufacturer-fitted accessories. Helmets, riding gear and items carried on the vehicle are not part of the insured vehicle.
clauses.plain: Your Pavan Breeze 125 scooter, MH 12 ME 7781, is insured; your helmet and things in the dicky are not.

clauses.title: Insured declared value (IDV)
clauses.text: The Insured Declared Value of ₹62,000 is the maximum amount payable for total loss or theft of the insured vehicle during this policy period. It is the manufacturer's listed selling price less depreciation for the age of the vehicle.
clauses.plain: The most we pay if the scooter is stolen or written off is ₹62,000.

clauses.title: Period and area of cover
clauses.text: This policy is in force from 1 February 2026 to 31 January 2027, both days inclusive, for loss or damage occurring within India.
clauses.plain: You are covered anywhere in India from 1 February 2026 to 31 January 2027.

clauses.title: Authorised rider
clauses.text: The vehicle may be ridden by the insured or any person riding with the insured's permission who holds a valid driving licence for a motorcycle with gear or without gear, as applicable to the insured vehicle.
clauses.plain: Anyone you allow to ride is covered if they hold a valid two-wheeler licence.

clauses.title: Accidental damage
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by accident by external means, including collision, skidding and falling, subject to the deductible and depreciation provisions of this policy.
clauses.plain: If the scooter is damaged in an accident or a fall, the repairs are covered.

clauses.title: Fire, flood and natural calamities
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by fire, explosion, self-ignition, lightning, flood, inundation, storm, cyclone, earthquake or landslide.
clauses.plain: Damage from fire, flood, storms or earthquakes is covered.

clauses.title: Theft
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of the insured vehicle by theft, and damage to it by attempted theft. A claim for theft of the entire vehicle is payable at the IDV less the deductible once the police issue a report that the vehicle is untraced.
clauses.plain: If your scooter is stolen and not found, we pay the IDV after the police confirm it is untraced.

clauses.title: Riot, strike and malicious damage
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by riot, strike, malicious act or terrorist activity.
clauses.plain: If someone damages your scooter on purpose, or in a riot or strike, it is covered.

clauses.title: Liability to third parties
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against legal liability arising out of the use of the insured vehicle for death of or bodily injury to any person, without limit, and for damage to third-party property up to ₹1,00,000 for any one accident. Third-party cover is compulsory under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
clauses.plain: If your scooter injures someone or damages their property, your legal liability is covered (property up to ₹1,00,000).

clauses.title: Owner-driver personal accident cover
clauses.text: The Company will pay ₹15,00,000 if the owner-driver named in the Schedule dies or suffers permanent total disablement as a result of an accident while riding, mounting or dismounting the insured vehicle, provided the owner-driver held a valid licence and was wearing a helmet where required by law. Lower amounts apply for partial disablement under the scale of compensation.
clauses.plain: If you are killed or permanently disabled riding your scooter, ₹15,00,000 is paid.

clauses.title: Pillion rider
clauses.text: Personal accident cover for a pillion rider has not been opted under this policy. Legal liability for injury to a pillion rider as a third party remains covered under Clause 3.1.
clauses.plain: Your pillion has no personal accident cover of their own, though your legal liability to them is covered.

clauses.title: 24x7 roadside assistance
clauses.text: The Company will arrange, through its assistance partner, towing of the insured vehicle up to 25 km to the nearest network garage, on-site minor repairs, a flat tyre repair, emergency fuel delivery of up to 2 litres (fuel cost payable by the insured) and help if the keys are locked or lost, anywhere in India.
clauses.plain: If your scooter stops on the road, call us for towing, a puncture repair or fuel.

clauses.title: Zero depreciation: not opted
clauses.text: The zero depreciation add-on has not been opted under this policy. Depreciation on replaced parts will be deducted as set out in Clause 5.2.
clauses.plain: When parts are replaced, depreciation is deducted, because zero depreciation was not taken.

clauses.title: Engine protection: not opted
clauses.text: The engine protection add-on has not been opted under this policy. Damage to the engine from water ingression, or from attempting to start the engine after it has been submerged, is not covered.
clauses.plain: Engine damage from water, such as starting the scooter after riding through a flooded road, is not covered.

clauses.title: Consumables: not opted
clauses.text: The consumables add-on has not been opted under this policy. Engine oil, nuts, bolts, grease, washers and similar consumables used in a repair are not payable.
clauses.plain: Oil, nuts, bolts and other consumables used in a repair are not covered.

sections.title: Deductible, depreciation and No Claim Bonus

clauses.title: Compulsory deductible
clauses.text: Each claim for loss of or damage to the insured vehicle is subject to a compulsory deductible of ₹500, borne by the insured.
clauses.plain: You pay the first ₹500 of every own-damage claim.

clauses.title: Depreciation on replaced parts
clauses.text: Depreciation will be deducted from the cost of parts replaced as follows: 50% on rubber, nylon and plastic parts, tyres, tubes and batteries; 30% on fibreglass components; nil on glass. Metal parts are depreciated at 10% for a vehicle aged one to two years. Labour charges are paid in full.
clauses.plain: You bear part of the cost of replaced parts, such as half the cost of plastic panels.

clauses.title: No Claim Bonus
clauses.text: A No Claim Bonus of 20% has been applied to the own-damage premium of this policy for one claim-free year. If no claim is made in this policy period the bonus will rise to 25% at renewal; a claim will reset it to 0%.
clauses.plain: You have a 20% No Claim Bonus; a claim this year resets it at renewal.

clauses.title: Riding under the influence
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for loss or damage, or personal accident compensation, if the rider was under the influence of alcohol or drugs at the time of the accident. Third-party liability is paid as required by law, with a right of recovery from the insured.
clauses.plain: Nothing for your scooter is paid if the rider was drunk.

clauses.title: Riding without a valid licence
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for loss, damage or liability if the rider does not hold a valid and effective licence to ride the class of vehicle. Third-party liability is paid as required by law, with a right of recovery.
clauses.plain: If the rider has no valid licence, the damage is not covered.

clauses.title: Breakdown, wear and tear
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for mechanical or electrical breakdown, wear and tear, rust or depreciation, or for damage to tyres and tubes unless the vehicle is damaged in the same accident.
clauses.plain: Breakdowns, wear and tear, and a damaged tyre on its own are not covered.

clauses.title: Use for hire or delivery
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable while the vehicle is used for hire or reward, including as a bike taxi or for commercial delivery of goods or food, or for racing or speed testing.
clauses.plain: Nothing is covered while the scooter is used as a bike taxi or for deliveries.

clauses.title: Claim intimation within 48 hours
clauses.text: Notice of any accident, loss or damage must be given to the Company within 48 hours by calling the claims helpline or online. Theft or a criminal act must be reported to the police immediately, and an FIR copy submitted with the claim.
clauses.plain: Tell us within 48 hours; for theft, also file an FIR straight away.

clauses.title: Survey, repairs and payment
clauses.text: Repairs must not begin until the Company's surveyor has inspected the vehicle and approved the estimate. At a network garage the Company pays the approved amount directly to the garage; elsewhere the insured is reimbursed by bank transfer within 7 working days of the final bill.
clauses.plain: Wait for our surveyor before repairs; network garages are paid directly.

clauses.title: Theft: keys and documents
clauses.text: For a theft claim the insured must surrender both original keys, the original registration certificate, the FIR and the police untraced report, and sign the transfer forms and a letter of subrogation.
clauses.plain: For a stolen scooter, give us both original keys, the RC and the police reports.

clauses.title: Transfer and cancellation
clauses.text: If the vehicle is sold, the new owner may apply within 14 days to transfer this policy. The insured may cancel the policy if the vehicle is insured elsewhere or sold, and receive a short-period refund if no claim has been made.
clauses.plain: If you sell the scooter, the buyer must apply within 14 days to take over the policy.
